description.zh: 报表发送方式，仅支持邮件发送，需进行JSON转义。
description.en: The method that is used to send operations reports. Operations reports are sent to you only by email. The settings must be escaped in JSON.
The ID of the tracking task that you want to update.

description.zh:
待订阅的域名列表，支持批量查询域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。
如果不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务。
description.en: The domain name that you want to track. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If you do not specify a domain name, the task collects data from all domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account.
The name of the tracking task.

description.zh: 待订阅的报表列表，需进行JSON转义。
description.en: The operations reports that are tracked by the task. The data must be escaped in JSON.

description.zh: 订阅周期相关参数，需进行JSON转义。
description.en: The parameters that specify the time interval at which the tracking task sends operations reports. The settings must be escaped in JSON.

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to three times per second.
